It's like being paranoid about a local fast food service worker poisoning the food delivery you opted to order, where the risks and penalties far outweigh the abuse.
Consent is still important and should be respected among verified 18+ status users.
@{68098a4626271974ef4d2775|full_name} yeah I have been seeing a lot of distrust, if you don't trust it yourself don't use it. this thread isnt meant for anti-trust comments in my oppinion

@{5e59bc346312bf2d549f33ab|full_name} I am not asking for more age verification, I am asking for the age verification we have to be utilized more in the ways I listed. I think this would be good for the already 18+ verified community and make adult spaces more cleary defined. If you personally don't trust the age verification system vrchat uses then don't use it.
Nice idea, i want age verified friend list and receive only friend request from others +18 verified guys
@{64e2bd1674393d094bec459c|full_name} I love that idea, having a setting to only allow friend requests from 18+ verified players

I'd take it a step further and make it so any instance, group, or avatar marked as 18+ is not even visible anywhere in game or on the website to people who are not 18+ verified.

- If Group A is marked as 18+ by the owner of the group, then if someone who is not 18+ verified searches for groups inside of VRChat, it won't even show on the list even if they search directly for it. They'd be unable to join it even if they somehow found it.

- If someone is using an avatar they uploaded and marked as 18+, then that avatar will be a fallback to anyone not 18+ verified no matter their shield settings; and even if that avatar could be made safe with toggles. Also, marking your avatar as 18+ would automatically make it non-public.

- If someone creates an instance that is 18+ verified only, then it would never show on instance lists for that world or anywhere else for someone who is not 18+ verified. If a non-verified friend sees you on their friend list and you are in an 18+ world, they would simply see you in "Private" and would not be able to join or request on you, no matter your status.

@{63a4f088dc4eb42719adf0a6|full_name} This is great, I agree with this. I wanted to keep it simple in my original post to leave room for this concept to be expanded on, I could also understand that doing it like this would be a lot more complicated (I'm not a coder but it looks like a lot more work) so I rather have something simple that works. details:
Feature Requests,

- Age Verified 18+ only, worlds; if you are not verified you cant join or open an instance of a world listed 18+

- Age Verified 18+ only, Groups; A group setting allowing you to set it to 18+ only, for players who aren't verified the banner, posts, description, rules ect. should be empty or have the placeholder "planet" banner.

- Age Verified 18+ only, User profiles; I want to have funny adult jokes in my bio, I cant rn. status, pronounce, icon, picture & bio. Profiles set to be 18+ should appear empty & have basic placeholder or default pictures.

- Age Verified 18+ only, Stickers/Prints; A verified account should be able to select an 18+ tag during the uploading of a sticker/print, making it only visibel to other 18+ verified players.

- Age Verified 18+ only, Avatars; The ability to set an avatar to 18+ during or after upload, 18+ avatars should not load in when used in a 18+ group instance or world. 18+ avatars should be hidden or shown as a fall back when using content gating while inside of an 18+ group instance or world.

I wasn't sure if I should even be posting this because I felt like there are so many other requests about 18+ avatars and groups, I felt like I had something to add that I didn't see in other requests and felt like grouping everything together was the right idea, especially since the most active posts are posted on 2019 and felt outdated.

If you agree with me pls upvote, have anything else to add? any concerns or questions please comment below. Thank you!
